LIST_DESCRIPTION: Drafts written by the daily Product Hunt job for products that could embed FastComments. Nothing is sent until you send it.
BULK_DENY_CONFIRM: Deny the selected drafts? They will not be sent.
NEEDS_REVIEW_WARNING: This draft tripped a formatting check. Read it closely before sending.
SEND_SAVES_HINT: Send saves your edits first, so what you see above is what goes out.
DENY_CONFIRM: Deny this draft? It will not be sent.
FLASH_INVALID: Need a valid email address, a subject, and a body.
FLASH_NOT_PENDING: This draft is no longer pending, so nothing changed.
FLASH_INCOMPLETE: This draft is missing a recipient, subject, or body.
FLASH_SEND_FAILED: Sending failed. The draft is still pending - try again.
FLASH_SUPPRESSED: That address is on the suppression list, so nothing was sent. The draft is still pending.
FLASH_TOO_LONG: That draft is too long to save. Shorten the subject or body and try again.
FLASH_BULK_SENT_PARTIAL: Sent {count} emails. Some failed and are still pending.
FLASH_BULK_DENIED_PARTIAL: Denied {count} drafts. Some were no longer pending.
FLASH_NOTHING_SELECTED: Select at least one draft first.
